name: 利用者セグメントの条件
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
One Japanese user-segment conditions component. Compact 350px logical width, allow about190px height so all ORIGINAL controls fit Japanese without clipping. Heading 比較する利用者 in20/28Bold. Beneath a compact header row: いずれか with down chevron; 利用者 with down chevron; small circled information i; right aligned 保存済み with down chevron. Restore these source controls omitted by mock, retaining thin slate glyphs. Below one white grouped segment box with neutral fine border and12px corners. Top row: segment number1 with small down chevron, すべての利用者, right vertical3-dot menu. Inset divider, bottom row three small text actions exactly ＋ 条件 / ＋ グループ / ＋ 行動. Beneath group, add action ＋ 比較するグループを追加 in forest green; do not invent additional selected segments or criteria. Preserve actual all-users default state. Source controls arrow/ellipsis/i geometry, row spacing and grouping, mock secondary Japanese wording. Remove mock broad mint block. Body14/24Regular, utility labels12/16Regular, zero tracking. Neutral text and slate icons on white, fine quiet lines; green reserved for add actions. No large decorative card, chart, count metric, logo or watermark.
Evidence-based accent decision: Original segment controls mostly neutral; add actions are plain links. Use coherent slate icons and neutral group surface, forest green only for add actions; no arbitrary category accent or green-washed group.
reviewNotes: 原画Amplitudeの母集団選択・保存済み・i・番号の開閉・縦3点を優先して復元。生成を目視し比較する利用者、いずれか、利用者、保存済み、1すべての利用者、＋条件/＋グループ/＋行動、＋比較するグループを追加を確認。1群の既定状態、白い面と中立線、スレートの同一太さの補助アイコン、追加リンクだけ森林緑。日本語に合わせ約190px高へ調整し欠落・クリップなし。所有者承認・フォント実体・編集可能性・実装未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
